about.headline: We are reviving the traditional ways of Old Bharat
about.intro: We believe the wisdom of Old Bharat still holds the secret to wholesome living. Age-old recipes, natural cooking methods and ingredients trusted by generations, made with modern quality standards.

blocks.title: How it started
blocks.body:
Our journey began with a simple belief: good food brings people together. A passion for wholesome, authentic flavours grew into a mission to make food that's nourishing, sustainable and crafted with care.

We work closely with farmer families and suppliers who share our values. Every product balances traditional recipes with modern sensibilities, so every bite is rich in taste and goodness.

blocks.title: A note from our founder

faq.a: Ghee made from the milk of indigenous cows like the Gir, which carries the A2 type of beta-casein protein. Ours is made from curd using the bilona method.
Milk is set into curd overnight, then churned with a wooden churner to separate the butter. That butter is slow cooked into ghee. It takes longer, and we think it tastes better.
Khapli is emmer wheat, an ancient heritage grain. We stone grind it on a chakki so the bran and fibre stay in.

articles.title: Curd, churn, cook: how bilona ghee is made
articles.body:
Most ghee on the shelf is made from cream or butter. Bilona ghee takes the long road.

First, whole milk from Gir cows is boiled, cooled and set into curd overnight. Next morning, the curd is churned with a wooden bilona until the butter (makkhan) separates from the buttermilk.

That butter is then slowly cooked until the moisture leaves and what remains is golden, grainy ghee with a nutty aroma.

It takes a lot more milk and a lot more time. That is exactly why it tastes the way Dadi’s did.

articles.title: Khapli: the ancient wheat making a comeback
articles.body:
Khapli, or emmer wheat, is one of the oldest cultivated grains. It was grown across India long before modern wheat varieties took over.

We stone grind it on a chakki at low speed. The flour stays cooler, and the bran and fibre stay in.

Rotis come out a little darker and nuttier than regular atta. Give it two or three meals, and most families don’t go back.

articles.title: Why stone pressed oil tastes different
articles.body:
Most refined oils are extracted with heat and chemical solvents, then bleached and deodorised.

Stone pressing crushes seeds slowly, at low temperature, with nothing added. The oil keeps its natural colour, aroma and flavour.

That’s why our mustard oil has its signature punch, and our groundnut oil actually smells of groundnuts.

legal.privacyText:
{company} ("Rosier", "we", "us") runs the Rosier Foods app. This policy explains what information the app collects, why, and the choices you have. We follow India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

## What we collect
- Account details when you log in: your name, email address and phone number. Login uses your Rosier (Shopify) customer account, the same one you use on rosierfoods.com.
- Delivery addresses you save, and your orders (items, amounts, delivery status).
- Rosier Coins, wishlist and cart contents, so they work across the app.
- A random app ID for this phone and, if you allow notifications, a notification token. We use these to send order updates and offers.
- Basic usage: when the app is opened and which phone type (Android or iPhone). We don't track you across other apps or websites.
- Reviews you choose to write (your name, rating, text), which are published on our product pages through Judge.me.
- A profile photo, only if you add one. It stays on your phone and is not uploaded.

We do not collect your location, contacts, or payment card details. Payments are handled securely by Shopify's checkout and its payment partners.

## How we use it
- To let you log in, place orders, track deliveries and use Rosier Coins.
- To send order updates and, if you allow, offers. You can turn notifications off any time in your phone's settings.
- To improve the app and fix problems.

We never sell your personal data.

## Who we share it with
- Shopify, which runs our store, customer accounts and checkout.
- Payment and delivery partners, only what they need to complete your order.
- Judge.me, for reviews you choose to post.
- Google Firebase and Apple, to deliver notifications.
- Google Cloud (servers in Mumbai, India), which hosts the app's server and stores its data securely.

## How long we keep it
We keep your account data while your account is active. When you delete your account we erase your personal data within {days} days, except records we must keep by law, such as invoices and tax (GST) records. App usage records (when the app was opened) are deleted automatically after 13 months.

## Your choices and rights
- See or update your details in the app (Profile → Account and Saved addresses).
- Delete your account from the app (Profile → Delete my account) or at /delete-account.
- Ask us anything about your data at {email}.
- Not happy with how we handled your data? Contact our grievance officer (details below).

## Children
The app is meant for adults (18+). We don't knowingly collect data from children.

## Contact
{company}
{address}
Email: {email}

We may update this policy. If we make important changes, we'll tell you in the app.

legal.termsText:
These terms apply when you use the Rosier Foods app ("the app"), run by {company} ("Rosier", "we", "us"). By using the app you agree to them. If you don't agree, please don't use the app.

## Using the app
- The app is meant for people aged 18 and above.
- You can browse without an account. To order, track orders, save addresses and earn Rosier Coins, you log in with your Rosier (Shopify) customer account using a code sent to your email.
- Keep access to your email safe. You're responsible for orders placed from your account.

## Orders, prices and payment
- Orders placed in the app are orders on our online store. They follow our store terms of service: {storeTerms}
- Prices, offers and stock can change. We confirm your order by email after payment.
- Payments are processed by Shopify's checkout and its payment partners. We never see or store your card details.
- Refunds, returns and cancellations follow our refund policy: {refunds}
- Delivery times and charges follow our shipping policy: {shipping}

## Rosier Coins, coupons and offers
- Rosier Coins and coupons have no cash value and can't be transferred or exchanged for money.
- How coins are earned and used is shown in the app. We may change or end these programmes, and we'll tell you in the app when we do.
- We may cancel coins, coupons or orders that come from misuse, fraud or technical errors.

## Reviews and content you post
- Reviews must be honest and about your own experience of the product.
- Don't post anything abusive, hateful, sexual, misleading, illegal, or anyone's personal details.
- Reviews are checked before they're published, and we may remove any review that breaks these rules.
- You can report a review in the app (tap "Report" on the review). We look at reports within 24 hours.
- By posting a review, you let us show it in the app and on our website.

## Notifications
If you allow notifications, we send order updates and, sometimes, offers. You can turn them off any time in your phone's settings.

## Product information
We take care to show correct product details, photos and prices. Always read the product label for ingredients, allergens and storage instructions. Our products aren't meant to diagnose, treat or cure any disease. If you have a medical condition or allergy, please check with your doctor.

## Fair use
Please don't misuse the app: no hacking, scraping, fake accounts, or using it for anything unlawful. We may suspend access if the app is misused.

## Our content
The Rosier name, logo, photos, recipes and text in the app belong to {company}. Please don't copy them without our written permission.

## Limits of our responsibility
We work hard to keep the app running and correct, but we can't promise it will always be available or error-free. To the extent the law allows, our responsibility for any order is limited to the amount you paid for it. Nothing in these terms takes away your rights under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

## Deleting your account
You can delete your account any time: Profile → Delete my account, or on the /delete-account page.

## Changes to these terms
We may update these terms. If the changes are important, we'll tell you in the app. Continuing to use the app means you accept the updated terms.

## Law and disputes
These terms are governed by the laws of India. Courts at Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, have jurisdiction.
